card.name: Words just before 'only if' or 'as needed'
card.fires_on: The last word of an instruction clause right before a qualifier such as 'only if', 'if possible', 'as soon as possible' or 'as required'. It is common in pregnancy statements, missed-dose advice and C. difficile management text.

modes.label: Pregnancy use clause
modes.description: Verb or 'to' in 'should be used/given ... only if clearly needed' statements.
modes.example: It should be given<< to>> a pregnant woman only if clearly needed.

modes.label: Missed-dose timing
modes.description: The word 'as' or 'dose' in 'take a missed dose as soon as possible'.

card.writes: It promotes conditional words such as 'unless' and 'if', so a condition is likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires on instruction wording just before a condition like 'only if needed' or 'as soon as possible'.
